description: This file defines the 'Customer' report controller for the Opencart admin extension. It handles rendering of the customer report page, saving report configuration, and generating report data, including pagination and filtering.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing the customer report in the Opencart admin panel. It handles displaying the report interface, processing user input to generate filtered reports, and saving report settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main customer report page with breadcrumbs, configuration options, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of report configuration settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer report data with filter options and grouping.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the user report data, mainly for AJAX requests or dynamic content.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the customer report data with filtering, pagination, and formatting.
